Door heights: 2.1m interior, 2.4m for the two exterior glazed doors (South main entrance, West corridor entrance).

F2 office doors (D_Off1_C..D_Off4_C) were re-measured by locating door-arc apex pixels in 2f_view.png and mapping via two-anchor pixel-to-metre conversion (anchors: building west/east wall faces at px 423/1814 = 0m/15m). Offices 1 and 2 both have doors flanking the x=3.75 partition (which carries a jamb/duct detail mark); offices 3 and 4 both flank the x=11.25 partition (same detail mark); the central x=7.5 partition (aligned with the ConfA/ConfB divide) is a plain wall with no office-side door pattern detected in the corridor-facing wall band.
Door width for F2 office doors assumed 0.75m, centered on the measured arc-apex pixel (arc apex approximates the door leaf outer corner/mid-swing, not a precisely labeled dimension).
